'''Frank White''' (5 March 1927 – 12 September 1994) was a [[botanist]] who was an expert on African flora and curator of the [[herbarium]] at the [[University of Oxford]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.independent.co.uk/news/people/obituary-frank-white-1443597.html|title=Obituary: Frank White|date=1994-10-18|publisher=[[The Independent]]|author=Q. C. B. Cronk and A. M. Sugden |accessdate=2012-05-24}}</ref>
